# PixelRyu

> PixelRyu is a solo Japanese indie game studio making small, polished, fully multilingual (12-language) games for Android, iOS, and Roblox.

PixelRyu (屋号: PixelRyu) is an independent developer based in Japan. This site is a multilingual portfolio (en, ja, zh, ko, hi, id, de, fr, it, es, pt, ru) with a page per game, plus a privacy policy and terms of service for each game. Language is selected client-side; English is the default content.

## Games

- [Okaeri](https://pixelryu.github.io/okaeri/): A cozy pet homecoming slide puzzle — slide rows and columns of glassy food bowls, rotate the outer ring of pets and owners, and reunite every pair across 60 quiet stages. Calm stages, no timer, 12 languages. Coming soon to the App Store, Google Play, and Roblox.
- [SENKO](https://pixelryu.github.io/senko/): A cozy, two-phase incense-smoke puzzle — light a stick of incense and sweep the restless dark smoke with a fingertip to calm it until it turns clear and white, then guide that white smoke to fill a faint Japanese motif (the moon, a pine, a crane, cherry blossoms and more) across 120 quiet stages. Dodge the red embers that burn your smoke back, and finish before the finite smoke runs out; a fan calms broadly and a brush helps you shape. 12 languages. Out now on the App Store and Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play.
- [Shizuku](https://pixelryu.github.io/shizuku/): A cozy, deterministic physics puzzle in a quiet Japanese garden — you never touch the dewdrops; instead you arrange the board (bamboo flumes, stones and leaves) so that two falling drops roll, slide and finally meet to become one. Set the scene, release the drops and watch your plan play out; nothing is random, so you can think the whole run through first. 12 languages. Out now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store.
- [WAGASHI](https://pixelryu.github.io/wagashi/): A cozy Japanese-sweets merge puzzle — drop a sweet into the vessel and two of the same merge into the next, climbing a 10-step chain from a tiny azuki bean (azuki) to a grand kagami-mochi. Soft round-body physics with a warning line at the vessel's mouth, two modes (endless Zen + 60 order stages within a move limit) and two tools (a fan and chopsticks), plus a Next preview. 12 languages. Now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store.
- [CounterParts](https://pixelryu.github.io/counterparts/): A cozy, minimalist mirror-twin grid puzzle — one swipe moves two twins, Gold (a warm golden glass drop) and Platinum (a cool silver-white glass drop), one cell each in opposite, point-symmetric directions; a wall or edge stops one twin while the other keeps going (desync), and you line both up to rest together on their matching-color holes inside a little brass tally counter. 120 levels in 7 families. Out now on the App Store and Roblox. Android in open testing on Google Play.
- [TEMARI](https://pixelryu.github.io/temari/): A first-person paddle breakout in a cozy Japanese night — move your hagoita (battledore) with a fingertip, keep the temari thread-ball in an endless rally, and pop every paper balloon down the lantern-lit corridor, with split balls, focus slow-motion, a pheasant helper and more. 8 worlds, 200 stages. Now on the App Store and Roblox; Android closed testing open.
- [TATAMI: Lay the Floor](https://pixelryu.github.io/tatami/): A cozy tatami-laying block puzzle in a quiet Japanese room — drag a mat and complete a full row or column to clear that line, while a samurai carries the finished mats to the tatami magistrate and delivering earns koban that buy extra lives. 48 stages. Now on Roblox; coming soon to the App Store.
- [Bounce Cat](https://pixelryu.github.io/bounce-cat/): A cozy maze-escape puzzle — a cat is trapped inside a walled maze you can't enter, so you fire a ball of yarn from the rim, ride the ricochet, and shift or shatter walls until the wandering cat rolls out to freedom. 200 mazes across 10 worlds. Now on the App Store and Roblox; Android closed testing open.
- [HAYATE](https://pixelryu.github.io/hayate/): A 3D katana speed-racer and sequel to ISSEN — dodge what flies at you, or throw a homing katana to slice it clean, across four worlds, forty stages, plus endless runs. iOS, Android & Roblox.
- [Sumlings](https://pixelryu.github.io/sumlings/): A cozy number puzzle — place number eggs into a tiny terrarium so each nest's total matches its target, hatching Sumlings to fill a collection. iOS, Android & Roblox.
- [Parcel Pals](https://pixelryu.github.io/parcel-pals/): A cozy parcel-sorting puzzle — sort cute parcels into three lanes and match shapes to boxes on the belt before the table overflows. iOS, Android & Roblox.
- [ISSEN (一閃)](https://pixelryu.github.io/issen/): A sumi-e (ink-wash) timing-action game built on the iaido draw — breathe, read the distance, unleash one perfect cut. iOS, Android & Roblox.
- [HOTARU (The Lost House)](https://pixelryu.github.io/hotaru/): A quiet, atmospheric first-person Japanese horror walking simulator set in a lost house. iOS, Android & Roblox.
- [Liquid Glow](https://pixelryu.github.io/liquid-glow-cosmic/): A calm, luminous color-matching puzzle in deep space — tap a glowing star, then a connected star, to slide its light along the constellation so each star's ring matches its color. Now on Roblox; coming soon to iOS (iPhone).
- [Liquid Glow (classic sort puzzle)](https://pixelryu.github.io/liquid-glow/): The original cozy, minimalist sort puzzle from Japan — arrange flowing liquid colors. Android.
- [Mole Whack (モグラぽかぽか)](https://pixelryu.github.io/mole-whack/): A casual stage-based whack-a-mole tap game across 100 stages — hit the moles, clear the target, advance. Android & iOS.
